required_action: Reward must auto-write accepted/rejected queues; raw selected queues cannot feed search directly.
Reward must reject candidates with negative OOS non-overlap floors.
Reward must compare original signal against controls before next-search acceptance.
Orientation must support full train and explicitly logged contiguous extension; tail-only orientation is not enough.
Search seeds must come from accepted_for_next_search after rerun under current reward code.
Rejected candidates and reasons must be retained for audit.
Pre-search launcher must point to a non-empty accepted_for_next_search queue, not a raw selected queue.
Queue filename must make the promotion status explicit.
